versions.subject: Merge PR #4525 from @nasbench
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\thor.exe'
        - '\thor64.exe'
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
        - '\thor.exe'
        - '\thor64.exe'
filter_main:
    Signed: 'true'
    SignatureStatus: 'valid'
    Signature: 'Nextron Systems GmbH'
condition: selection and not filter_main
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\thor.exe", "*\\thor64.exe") ImageLoaded IN ("*\\thor.exe", "*\\thor64.exe") NOT (Signed="true" SignatureStatus="valid" Signature="Nextron Systems GmbH")
